rule: Sam, 2026-11-17, relayed by COBIx on #3358 section 2: collect with gaps noted and confidence scores; Commons Clarity's Part B (#3480, comment 6967374303); COBIx's D2 decision (major total differs, about 30); Sam's routine prompt of 2026-11-25, as the S739 conductor's brief carries it: a record held for a gap is collected with its gap named and a lower score on the 0-100 bar, never held, unless the record is not the program's own; S739: Modesto Junior's records kb/receipts/program_requirement_records_piles_s731_pooled_2026-11-25_s731p.json held, read again by key: passed by a rescore where today's scorer's one reading moves them, else collected with their gaps named where the record is the program's own (no reread, no reconcile)

gaps.units_within_printed_range: The courses' units as read fall within the printed range of units rather than matching it.

records.words: the courses' units add to 23, within the printed 19-23 units | The outer 'REQUIRED COURSES (10 - 20 units)' heading shows '(Total 20)' / 'Complete the following number of credits: 20', but the description lays out two paths: non-native learners take SPAN 101, 102, 103, 110 plus one List A course; native/heritage learners take SPAN 109 and 110 plus List A electives to reach the minimum. The eLumen structure (SPAN 101+102 all; choose 5 units of SPAN 109 or SPAN 103; SPAN 110) does not cleanly encode these paths; reviewer should check.

outcomes: WRITING- Students will be able to write detailed and well organized letters, essays, or reports on a range of topics, in Spanish, at an intermediate proficiency level with minimal errors in grammar, spelling, and mechanics.
SPEAKING -Students will be able to actively participate in conversations and discussions, in Spanish, with a degree of fluency and spontaneity that makes interaction with Spanish-speakers possible.
READING-Students will be able to read critically about literary texts, articles and reports produced in Spanish.

LISTENING- Students will be able to recognize the linguistic variations that exists within the Spanish-speaking world and understand the main points in conversations, radio, television programs, and film.

blocks.name: LIST A - SELECT AT LEAST ONE

representation: checks.gaps and checks.confidence added as the load reads the filed score (a passing row: checks.arithmetic to equal); checks.coverage, invented and the record unchanged
claim_check_reads: Today's capture (sources.json): every course an entry names among the codes it found, and a course an entry says the printed total leaves out on neither it nor the state's list. A note's quoted figures are the reader's words, never re-read here.
follow_verdict: The follow_verdict trigger marks a row checked when its latest verdict is a confirm whose fingerprint matches the record and the machine checks pass. The record is unchanged here, so such a confirm on a row this plan moves to passing would check it at the apply, and the rollback would skip it. The pre-read counts those rows (confirm_matches); the apply aborts, writing nothing, unless the count is 0.
